content.text:
**Root cause and fix:** For even-length lists, `median()` in `toyrepo/stats.py` averaged `ordered[mid]` and `ordered[mid + 1]`, which is the wrong pair of middle values; I changed it to average `ordered[mid - 1]` and `ordered[mid]`, and the tests went from 5 of 6 passing to all 6 passing. The sandbox check worked as intended: an attempt to edit `tests/test_stats.py` was rejected with "Read-only file system", so the test expectations are protected.
